name: labcorp_draw_guidance
description: Surfaces Labcorp tube/draw guidance (tube type, count, draw volume) for in-progress Labcorp lab orders via an always-visible note header button that opens the breakdown in the right chart pane.

handlers.description: Always-visible note header action button ("AccuDraw"); opens the consolidated tube breakdown for the note's lab order(s) in the right chart pane.
